cad.box3-local-body:
# box3-local-body — hollow shell, four cored bosses, two gusset ribs
# (viewer_check `meshes` fixture: a box3-shaped realized enclosure)
component shell
wall   add box:w200mmd150mmh100mm
cavity cut box:w190mmd140mmh96mm @0mm,0mm,4mm
component boss-1
body1  add cyl:r8mmh90mm @85mm,60mm,-5mm
core1  cut cyl:r2.5mmh100mm @85mm,60mm,-5mm
component boss-2
body2  add cyl:r8mmh90mm @-85mm,60mm,-5mm
core2  cut cyl:r2.5mmh100mm @-85mm,60mm,-5mm
component boss-3
body3  add cyl:r8mmh90mm @85mm,-60mm,-5mm
core3  cut cyl:r2.5mmh100mm @85mm,-60mm,-5mm
component boss-4
body4  add cyl:r8mmh90mm @-85mm,-60mm,-5mm
core4  cut cyl:r2.5mmh100mm @-85mm,-60mm,-5mm
component gusset-1
rib1   add box:w40mmd10mmh30mm @0mm,65mm,-35mm
component gusset-2
rib2   add box:w40mmd10mmh30mm @0mm,-65mm,-35mm

ops.name: enclosure
ops.desc: box3-shaped realized enclosure: hollow shell, four cored bosses, two gussets (viewer meshes fixture).

ops.name: lid
ops.desc: Cover plate, UNBOUND on purpose: the meshes-on render must keep it as a plain envelope (fallback witness).
ops.use: envelope-fallback witness under the meshes toggle
